entries.promptSummary: Group Management Phase 3: welcome and goodbye messages
changes: Added a group-participants.update listener that sends welcome and goodbye messages for activated groups
Honors the per-group welcome and goodbye toggles added in Phase 2, independently of each other
Added an editable groupMessages section to the Bot Content editor with a Group Messages submenu
Added groupName and memberCount placeholders, resolved raw so a group name keeps its casing and counts stay as digits
Sends to the group chat rather than a participant DM, through sendText so the outbound rate limiter still applies
Added admin logging for group_member_joined and group_member_left with the system actor, only when a message is sent
Added 16 unit tests for the participant handler, plus a botContent.json snapshot so the suite cannot leave a template edit behind

entries.promptSummary: Group Management Phase 2: per-group settings + editable defaults
changes: Added per-group settings panel with six toggles for mention-only, chat rules, welcome, goodbye, anti-spam and anti-link
Added per-group language selection, shown with the native language name and flag
Added an editable new-group defaults file that activateGroup reads when seeding a group, filling only keys the group is missing
Replaced the read-only Defaults placeholder with a working editor restricted to bot admins
Added the /groupsettings command with a gset alias, DM-only so it can never run in a group
Wired settings, language, defaults and deactivate changes into the admin log with stringified payloads, reusing the existing group_deactivated action
Added 15 unit tests for per-group settings and defaults, running against temporary files so live group data is never touched

entries.promptSummary: Group Management Phase 1: activation and routing
changes: Added groups.json registry and groupService with activate, deactivate, update and per-group settings accessors
Replaced the unconditional group guard with an activation-aware group router; group messages can no longer reach DM onboarding, welcome-back, chat rules or menus
Added group metadata, admin-check and mention helpers with a participant-metadata cache
Added the DM Group Management submenu with My Groups, Activate, Deactivate and a read-only Defaults view, reachable via /groups, /gm or main-menu option 7
Added permission checks so only bot admins or admins of a specific group can view or change that group
Added admin logging for group_activated and group_deactivated with stringified payloads
Added 16 unit tests for the group registry and tracked data/groups.json plus the reserved data/groupStats.json
Added outbound rate limit service with per-chat (8/min) and global (40/min) caps as a spam-flag safety net, separate from the existing inbound conversation limiter
Gated outbound sends centrally in the messageService sendRaw funnel and the sendMenu chokepoint, so menus and text replies are covered without touching every call site
Added bypassRateLimit for admin/system notifications so a spam warning can never be suppressed by the limit it is reporting
Added admin warning after repeated blocks, rate-limited to once per cooldown window, delivered via direct send
Added sendDocument and wired the five user-facing export sends in chat, faq and feedback through it
Added 15 unit tests for the limiter on the built-in node test runner, registered as the 16th link in the existing test chain
Disabled the limiter in the three test suites that legitimately exceed the per-minute caps in-process, so they assert real behavior instead of throttling

entries.promptSummary: Fix Missing Translations and Unregistered Handlers
changes: Added the 24 missing Bot Content translation keys that the menus actually reference (group.*, variant.*, language.*, field.onboardingRetryMaxAttempts, admin.systemSettings.optionBotContent) to all five locales, fixing menu rows that rendered as raw dotted key paths
Made t() fall back to the last key segment in small caps instead of returning the raw dotted key, so a missing translation can never leak a path like menu.bot_content.variant.a1 into a menu
Registered every custom menu action handler into menuRouter's own registry at startup, so a custom: action resolves regardless of which router path reached it
Fixed Bot Content options 5-9 (preview, export, import, snapshots, reset) reporting "this menu is unavailable right now" when reached through the generic menu guard, which passed no handlers map
Fixed the Custom Commands menu, whose six handlers lived in a handler map that no runtime caller passed while auditMenus() aggregated all of them and so reported the menu healthy
Added allMenuCustomHandlers as the single aggregate handler export, used by the router, the runtime registration and the menu audit so they cannot drift apart again
Fixed bot_content_toggle_smallcaps calling a non-existent export (botContentToggleSmallcaps) and throwing a TypeError that surfaced as "unavailable"
Gave menu action failures a reason code and, for admins, an on-chat diagnostic naming the action, the reason and any error text, instead of one indistinguishable message
Reworked scripts/auditTranslations.mjs to simulate startup registration and report resolvable, inline-branch and genuinely-missing tiers separately; it now exits non-zero only on a real defect
Pinned the clock in a time-of-day dependent onboarding assertion that only passed during part of the day (French night greeting is "Salut", not "Bonjour")

entries.promptSummary: Fix menu routing + static main menu + idle-then-hint flow
changes: Added a router guard so a registered currentMenu is resolved before chat rules, fixing numbered options falling through to a greeting
Cleared stale menu ids with a warning instead of stranding the user
Added a second guard in handleFreeText so chat rules refuse to run while a menu is open
Reverted the main menu heading to a static translated Main Menu
Added an idle-then-hint flow that suggests /start after a chat reply or welcome-back, with delay, cooldown and quiet hours
Added six timing fields for the hint to the Bot Content editor
Added a startup menu audit for dangling references, duplicate option numbers and malformed options
Added editable bot content store backed by data/botContent.json with code defaults as the safety net
Moved onboarding, resume and welcome-back copy behind content templates with placeholder substitution
Added an admin editor under System Settings with field, variant, timing and language screens
Added preview, JSON export and import, snapshots and per-section reset
Made typing and welcome-back timings admin-editable with config.js kept as the fallback
Made language names and flags editable, with small caps applied everywhere

entries.promptSummary: Part 1: /try end fix + main menu greeting header
changes: Made /try end interrupt onboarding, the language menu and the cooldown lock
Cleared onboarding and resume session flags when a try session ends
Added a personalized Hello heading to the main menu
Added dynamicHeading support to the menu renderer with a headingKey fallback

entries.promptSummary: Fix triple-message bug + unified resume flow
changes: Added speaker coordinator so exactly one flow answers each message
Cooldown now expires silently instead of auto-sending a reminder and a fresh confirmation
Unified cooldown and long-gap resume into one prompt with a warmer long-gap variant
Resume yes continues from the core prompt without the brand heading or greeting
Resume no sends one polite close and starts an idle window
Three escalating nudges then silence on unclear resume replies
Language names are now small-capped everywhere
Greet returning users based on how long they were away and whether onboarding finished
Track lastSeen on every message with batched disk writes
Stay silent during the onboarding cooldown lock and any half-finished wizard
Accept emoji answers and fall back to a nameless greeting when the push name is unusable
Add a Welcome Back Messages toggle to General Settings

entries.promptSummary: Verify build integrity before Suga redeploy
changes: Fixed startup crash when pino-pretty is not installed
Logger falls back to plain output in production
Verified all imports resolve and all files parse
Confirmed config works without env vars
Added changelog manager menu with 8 admin actions
Added draft service and auto-draft creation from dev changes
Added publish, edit and delete for changelog entries
Added add-entry wizard and set-version flow
Added changelog export and import
Added dev-changes service with pending detection
Added dev-change formatter for single and aggregated notices
Added startup notification with toggle and guard
Added on code change toggle to bot notifications
Added dev change reader tests
Migrated version history to JSON
Added changelog service with pagination
Added subscribe placeholder
Added changelogBody menu resolver
Added changelog tests
